_notes: STATE 15 Nov 2026: mid-migration. ACTIVE transport is plain FTP to the OLD 34sp cluster (80.82.113.174, vsFTPd 2.2.2, Apache 2.2.15, receiver reports PHP 7.4.33, upgraded from the 5.6.36 seen up to Oct), which still takes ALL traffic because DNS still points there. ftp.knocbrac.com is a CNAME of knocbrac.com, so when the A record flips to the new cluster this host will point at a box with NO FTP (port 21 closed there): FTP deploys will then fail loudly, which is intended. Any post-flip access to the old cluster (results re-sync, decommission checks) must use the IP 80.82.113.174 explicitly. use_tls=true just means try FTPS first: FTPS login 530s on the old host and deploy falls back to plain FTP, so the password travels in clear text (accepted until cutover). The old cluster's sshd (OpenSSH 5.3) gives no usable home, so key auth there was never possible (18 Oct). The NEW cluster is parked in _sftp_when_migrated above; cutover steps, including the mandatory learn/results/ re-sync old to new, are in docs/plans/migration-cutover.md. The first deploy to the new cluster must use --all, because .deploy-manifest-knocbrac.json records what the OLD host has. sftpcli runs with BatchMode=yes, so it needs key auth (no password prompts) and batches every upload into one session. Fallback if keys ever break: transport=sftp (paramiko + password, pip install paramiko).
